analysis.modernInfo: Elevated sebum secretion secondary to androgenic sensitivity, follicular hyperkeratinization, and Cutibacterium acnes colonization leading to erythematous follicular papules.
analysis.ayurvedicInfo: Pitta and Rakta dushti with Vata aggravation leading to blockage of Swedavaha and Medovaha srotas in the Mukha pradesha (facial region).

detailedRootCause.modern: Sebaceous gland hyperactivity, microcomedone accumulation, and inflammatory cascade.
detailedRootCause.ayurvedic: Pitta-Kapha imbalance with localized Rakta Dhatu vitiation.

symptoms: Erythematous inflammatory papules on malar region

ayurvedicRemedies.title: Lodhradi Lepa Application
ayurvedicRemedies.instructions: Apply fine paste of Lodhra, Dhanyaka, and Vacha with rose water daily for 20 mins.

ayurvedicRemedies.title: Manjishtadi Kwatha Oral Regimen
ayurvedicRemedies.instructions: 15ml with equal warm water twice daily before meals for Rakta Shodhana.

modernRemedies.title: Topical Adapalene & Clindamycin
modernRemedies.instructions: Apply pea-sized amount over affected areas at night after gentle cleansing.

modernRemedies.title: Niacinamide 5% & Zinc Barrier Serum
modernRemedies.instructions: Apply morning and night to regulate sebum and restore epidermal barrier.
